The mechanism is verifiable in the diff (no clamp/max on limit).

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-24: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` followed by `members = group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no upper bound validation on the limit parameter - a client can pass an arbitrarily large value like `limit=1000000` which would be converted to an integer and used directly in the database query. This could allow fetching all members of a large group in a single request, potentially causing performance issues. The finding correctly identifies this as a missing validation that could exhaust resources.
